query_database.py:249 `_first_unanswered_tool_use` loops `range(start, len(messages))`, so the returned index is always >= start or None. `_trim_unanswered_tool_use` (298-323) passes that index as the `truncate_messages` length, and the store (conversation_store.py:130-138) drops only messages at or past that length. So no message at an index below start (the baseline from `_conversation_baseline`, line 224, read under the turn lock) is ever cut. Falsification inputs traced: (a) baseline larger than the current history gives an empty range, so the result is None and nothing is truncated. (b) A store that returns a shorter list also gives an empty range or only indices >= start, so the cut is still >= start. Truncate never removes a message below start. The claim is limited to start-bounded scanning, which the code does. The rejection line about a None return is a different subject and is not needed.
